observations: Photo shows a dark-wood TV console/stand with multiple open shelves and two cabinet doors (one on left side, lower one at bottom).
Small decorative items on top: a blue cup, a framed photo, and two narrow shelf/ledge pieces.
A black flat-screen TV sits on the upper platform of the console, with visible cables bundled below it.
Background is patterned wallpaper; floor is tiled, suggesting an indoor living room setting.
Watermark reads 'POSTED ON JIJI SHITTU KABIRU'.
No center table is visible anywhere in the photo, despite being mentioned in the listing text.

claims.claim: Listing includes a center table and TV console for 140k
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows only the TV console; no center table is visible in any image.
Subjective sales language, not a factual claim that can be checked from a photo.

claims.claim: TV shown is included in sale (implied by placement)
claims.evidence: No photo caption or text confirms the TV is part of the deal; could be seller's own TV used just for display.

risks.risk: Center table condition, material, and even existence cannot be confirmed since it's not shown in any photo.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the center table alone, showing all sides and surface condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price the pair as if the center table is in worst-case (heavily used/damaged) condition, or exclude it from valuation entirely.

risks.risk: TV console's structural integrity (hinges, back panel, warping) cannot be verified from a single angled photo.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of cabinet doors open, back panel, and corners/edges for chips or water damage.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cosmetically worn/moderate condition, not as 'like new'.

risks.risk: Material is unclear - could be particleboard/veneer rather than solid wood, affecting durability and value.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of an edge or damaged corner showing cross-section of the material.

risks.risk: TV's inclusion in the sale is ambiguous; if included, its size/brand/working status is unknown.
risks.proof: Seller confirmation in writing plus a photo of the TV's brand label/model and it powered on.
risks.if_unproven: Treat TV as NOT included in the console/table price.

proof_requests: Photo(s) of the center table from multiple angles.
Confirmation (and photo) of whether the TV is included in the 140k price.
Close-up shots of console cabinet interiors, hinges, and back panel.
A photo showing any damage, scratches, or repairs on the console.
response.reason: The listing price covers two items, but only the TV console is shown; without any image of the center table, even a worst-case price for the pair cannot be set.
